scope: Independent static review and synthetic boundary checks only. LSDA action displacement is based at the displacement operand; cycles, record/type overlap and configured limits fail closed. Fixed-width type-table pointers retain explicit indirection for a separate checked resolver. Supported CFI opcodes produce ordered instruction/state observations, including intermediate states at the same PC, rather than complete PC-range unwind rows. Unsupported restore/state-stack/expression operations reject. This does not validate actual unwinding, landing-pad execution, exception matching or managed EH recovery.
